facts.text: The Nurmiste Press Council commissioned her essay cycle Jõekaldad for display at Toomemägi Reading Hall.
Her praised masterclass Allikakontroll is hosted by the Nurmiste Press Council and funded by the Valguskilp Foundation.
She serves with distinction on the Emajõgi Transparency Jury, convened by Tartumaa Civic Archive with Hiiekivi Reader Trust.
Her admired investigation series Kuldne Sulg runs jointly with the Süda-Eesti Data Lab and Verevalge Collective.
She returns each spring to Paluveski for the Jõesuu Lecture Nights, programmed by Kivisilla Kultuurikoda.
